## Teammate

---

[Bientity Condition Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Teammate)

Checks whether two entities are part of the same scoreboard team. If either entity is not part of a scoreboard team, then this condition will evaluate to false.

Type ID: `proviorigins:teammate`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
"bientity_condition": {
    "type": "proviorigins:teammate"
}
```
